utm.intro: UTM parameters are invisible tags you attach to your ad destination URLs. They travel with every click — from ad → landing page → SPIN AI — giving the AI full context about who the lead is and what made them click, before the first message is sent.
utm.termPurpose: Keyword or audience interest that matched
utm.campaignPurpose: Maps to your Product. Set this to match your product's UTM Campaign Slug:
utm.contentPurpose: Maps to your Offer. Which specific ad creative or offer the user clicked. Set this to your offer's UTM Content Slug.
utm.personaPurpose: Maps to your Persona. Tells the AI which audience profile this lead matches so it opens the conversation with their exact pain points and desires.
utm.exampleUrlNote: Replace vendia.vip with your domain. Each ad set targeting a different persona or promoting a different offer should use its own utm_persona and utm_content — this is how the AI personalizes each conversation.
utm.platformsTitle: Setting Up in Your Ad Platform
utm.metaBody: In your ad, go to Ad → Destination → Website URL. Paste the full URL with all UTM parameters in the destination field. For multiple ad sets (one per persona), duplicate the ad set and change only utm_persona and utm_content.
utm.googleBody: Use the Final URL field with the complete URL + UTMs. Alternatively, use the Final URL suffix to append parameters automatically: utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=…
utm.tiktokBody: In your ad creation flow, set the Landing Page URL to the full URL with UTM parameters appended. TikTok also supports click tracking macros like {{campaign_name}} for dynamic values.
utm.autoBody: Your Vorrai landing page automatically reads every UTM parameter from the URL on page load. When a visitor fills in their name and email and submits the form, all UTM values are attached to the submission. No hidden fields, no custom scripts, nothing to configure on the landing page.
utm.flowTitle: How the SPIN AI Uses UTM Data
utm.flow1Body: User clicks your ad. UTM params are embedded in the destination URL.
utm.flow2Body: Page silently captures all UTM values. User submits name + email.
utm.flow3Body: User receives a link with their unique chat token. UTM data travels along inside the system.
utm.flow4Body: Before the first message, the AI already knows: which product they're interested in (utm_campaign), which persona profile they match (utm_persona), and which offer caught their eye (utm_content). The opening is already personalized — no cold start.
utm.proTip: Pro tip: Run a separate ad set per persona, each with its own utm_persona value matching one of the personas you created above. When a lead enters the chat, the AI opens with that persona's exact pain points and desires — not a generic script. The result feels like the AI read their mind.
